reason: We have always washed by hand at home and it gets done; paying twenty-two thousand for a machine, battery or no battery, is not something my household feels it needs. If I ever bought a washer, a plain one would come first, and the battery part is solving a problem I don't have yet.
objection: Who will repair it in my village, and what will a new battery cost after three years? The dealer is in the block town, not at my door, and a big battery can cost almost as much as the machine.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour I trust had one working for a year with the dealer actually coming to the village for repairs, and the replacement battery price was written down and low.
